what: Add a --title-only option to `prismis-daemon refetch` that narrows its selection to unreadable items whose analysis records title_only = true.
why: Design: docs/work/refetch-title-only/design.md. The HN discussion backfill on <host> should recover the 39 flagged title-only HN items the reader sees, not the 1,304 never-analysed ones refetch's current selection also takes.

criteria.given: a real test database with non-archived unreadable rss rows flagged title_only true, flagged false, and with no title_only key, plus an archived flagged row and a readable flagged row
criteria.then: it fails if any row other than the non-archived unreadable title_only-true rows is returned, or they are not oldest first, or --limit counts unflagged rows; otherwise exactly those rows return, oldest first, up to the limit, and the test is shown red with the json_extract clause removed
it fails if its result differs from today's selection (every non-archived unreadable row of the type, flagged or not); otherwise it is unchanged
it fails if the reported count is not the flagged unreadable count or a cost estimate is missing; otherwise both are reported and no extraction, LLM call or write happens
it fails on any failing check; otherwise its last line is `verify: PASS`

outOfScope: The 1,304 unflagged HN rows that were never analysed, and the 4 with title_only false, stay as they are.
stakes: With --title-only, refetch selects only non-archived, unreadable rows of the given type whose analysis records title_only = true, oldest first, up to --limit; rows with title_only false or no title_only key are never selected.
Without --title-only, the selection is exactly what it is today, rows with no title_only key included.
refetch --dry-run --title-only reports the narrowed selection's count and cost estimate.
On <host> after deploy, refetch --type rss --title-only --dry-run selects the 39 flagged HN items, and the real run reports how many were recovered from their discussion.
